manifest_changes.name: bitcoin-cfg
manifest_changes.description_after: build dependency for specifying cfg aliases and cargo directives

manifest_changes.name: bitcoin-crc32c
manifest_changes.description_after: High-performance CRC32C (Castagnoli) implementation with runtime-dispatched SSE4.2 and AArch64 backends plus a portable fallback, suitable for streaming integrity checks in Bitcoin and other systems code.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoin-derive
manifest_changes.description_after: A procedural macro crate providing attributes for concurrency control, signal-slot mechanisms, and fuzz testing, designed for Bitcoin-related Rust projects.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoin-imports
manifest_changes.description_after: encapsulates most third party deps for the bitcoin ecosystem

manifest_changes.name: bitcoin-leveldb
manifest_changes.description_after: Facade for the modular LevelDB port in bitcoin-rs. It re-exports selected component crates; it does not add a separate ergonomic database wrapper.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoin-support
manifest_changes.description_after: Low-level support primitives for bitcoin-rs: secure allocators with mlock+zeroization, libevent-compatible opaque event handles, optimizer-resistant memory cleansing, alignment and unique-path utilities.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-arena
manifest_changes.description_after: Arena allocation for the bitcoin-rs LevelDB port. Arena hands out raw byte storage from retained blocks and releases its backing storage when dropped.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-batch
manifest_changes.description_after: Ordered write batches for the bitcoin-rs LevelDB implementation.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-block
manifest_changes.description_after: Read-only LevelDB table data blocks and their iterators.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-blockbuilder
manifest_changes.description_after: Builds the prefix-compressed data and index blocks used in LevelDB SSTables. BlockBuilder stores shared-key prefixes, periodic restart keys, and a restart offset array; it does not write an SSTable file itself.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-blockconstructor
manifest_changes.description_after: Block-construction fixtures for LevelDB iterator and table tests.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-blockcontents
manifest_changes.description_after: The byte view and ownership metadata passed between LevelDB block readers and block objects.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-blockhandle
manifest_changes.description_after: Block locations and block-reading helpers for LevelDB SSTable files. BlockHandle records an offset and payload size, encodes them as varints, and decodes them with a Status result. BLOCK_TRAILER_SIZE describes the trailing compression-type byte and checksum.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-blockiter
manifest_changes.description_after: Iteration over the prefix-compressed entries of a LevelDB block.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-blockutil
manifest_changes.description_after: Low-level decoding of a LevelDB table-block entry header.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-bloom
manifest_changes.description_after: LevelDB-style Bloom filters for the bitcoin-rs storage subsystem. The policy uses the name leveldb.BuiltinBloomFilter2 and records its probe count in the filter's final byte.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-cache
manifest_changes.description_after: Handle-based caching used by the bitcoin-rs LevelDB storage engine.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-cfg
manifest_changes.description_after: Compile-time constants used by the LevelDB implementation.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-coding
manifest_changes.description_after: Binary encoding primitives used by the bitcoin-rs LevelDB port: fixed-width little-endian integers, 32/64-bit varints, and length-prefixed slices.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-compaction
manifest_changes.description_after: Compaction plans and bookkeeping for the LevelDB storage engine.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-compactionstats
manifest_changes.description_after: Per-level counters for LevelDB compaction work.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-comparator
manifest_changes.description_after: Bytewise key ordering and key-shortening operations for the bitcoin-rs LevelDB port. SliceComparator combines comparison, a stable name, shortest separator, short-successor, and bytewise-comparator access.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-compat
manifest_changes.description_after: Platform-port helpers used by the bitcoin-rs LevelDB implementation.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-crc32
manifest_changes.description_after: CRC32C checksums and LevelDB checksum masking.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-db
manifest_changes.description_after: C-API-style database handles and Rust functions for the bitcoin-rs LevelDB implementation. This crate exposes raw-pointer operations such as leveldb_open, leveldb_put, leveldb_get, leveldb_write, iterator/snapshot operations, and the corresponding close/destroy/free functions. These are Rust functions; this crate does not declare a C ABI or exported extern "C" entry points.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-dbconstructor
manifest_changes.description_after: Database-backed construction fixtures for the LevelDB comparison harness.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-dbimpl
manifest_changes.description_after: The persistent LevelDB database implementation behind the DB operation traits.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-dbimplinner
manifest_changes.description_after: Internal background-compaction and coordination helpers for the bitcoin-rs LevelDB database implementation. This crate separates scheduling predicates, background-error recording, waiter notification, manual-compaction boundaries, and compaction-state preparation from the main database implementation.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-dbimplwriter
manifest_changes.description_after: Per-writer queue state for LevelDB's database write path.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-dbinterface
manifest_changes.description_after: Operation traits for LevelDB-style databases.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-dbiter
manifest_changes.description_after: User-visible database iteration over LevelDB internal keys. DBIter filters entries by a snapshot sequence number, hides deletion records and older values, and supports forward and reverse traversal across user keys.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-dbiterstate
manifest_changes.description_after: Iterator cleanup state for retained LevelDB memtables and versions.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-dumpfile
manifest_changes.description_after: Text inspection of individual LevelDB storage files.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-duplex
manifest_changes.description_after: Two-level iteration for LevelDB tables: an index iterator identifies blocks, and a caller-supplied BlockFunction opens each block's data iterator. TwoLevelIterator presents their entries as one forward/reverse sequence, skipping empty blocks and retaining encountered errors in its status.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-emptyiterator
manifest_changes.description_after: An always-invalid LevelDB iterator with a stored status.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-env
manifest_changes.description_after: Operating-system services and file helpers used by the LevelDB implementation.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-erroriterator
manifest_changes.description_after: Constructs an empty iterator carrying a supplied Status, for paths where a table or other iterator source could not be opened.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-file
manifest_changes.description_after: File interfaces, database filename helpers, and file metadata for LevelDB.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-filter
manifest_changes.description_after: Filter-policy interfaces and the filter blocks stored in LevelDB table files.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-footer
manifest_changes.description_after: Encoding and decoding of the fixed-size footer at the end of a LevelDB SSTable. Footer contains the metaindex and index BlockHandle values; the serialized footer includes padding and the table magic number.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-harness
manifest_changes.description_after: Shared comparison harness for LevelDB blocks, tables, and databases.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-hash
manifest_changes.description_after: The seeded 32-bit hash used by LevelDB's internal data structures.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-histogram
manifest_changes.description_after: Fixed-bucket online statistics used by LevelDB benchmarks and diagnostics. Histogram tracks sample count, extrema, sum, sum of squares, and 154 buckets without retaining individual samples.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-iterator
manifest_changes.description_after: Owning wrapper for the LevelDB iterator trait interface.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-iteratorinner
manifest_changes.description_after: The operation traits and cleanup nodes used by LevelDB iterators.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-key
manifest_changes.description_after: Internal-key encoding and comparison for the bitcoin-rs LevelDB port. An internal key appends an eight-byte sequence/type tag to a user key. User keys sort according to their supplied comparator; equal user keys sort by decreasing packed sequence/type tag so newer entries are visited first.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-keyconvertingiterator
manifest_changes.description_after: Iterator adapter that exposes user keys from LevelDB internal keys.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-limiter
manifest_changes.description_after: A non-blocking resource counter used by LevelDB's POSIX file implementations.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-log
manifest_changes.description_after: Convenience re-exports for the bitcoin-rs LevelDB logging components. This crate's library contains no separate log implementation; it re-exports:

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-logreader
manifest_changes.description_after: Logical-record reader for LevelDB's block-framed write-ahead log format.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-logtools
manifest_changes.description_after: Shared LevelDB log-format definitions and diagnostic formatting helpers.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-logwriter
manifest_changes.description_after: Writes LevelDB log records to a WritableFile. LogWriter::add_record splits a logical record into full/first/middle/last physical records, writes CRC32C headers, and pads the unused tail of a log block when required.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-lru
manifest_changes.description_after: Low-level sharded LRU cache primitives from the LevelDB implementation.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-memenv
manifest_changes.description_after: An in-memory Env implementation for LevelDB tests and transient databases.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-memtable
manifest_changes.description_after: The in-memory sorted write table for the bitcoin-rs LevelDB port. MemTable stores encoded entries in an arena-backed skiplist, ordered by internal key. add records a sequence number, value/deletion type, key, and value; get performs a sequence-aware lookup, and new_iterator exposes internal entries.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-merger
manifest_changes.description_after: Merge cursor for sorted LevelDB child iterators.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-modeldb
manifest_changes.description_after: An in-memory reference database used by LevelDB comparison tests.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-options
manifest_changes.description_after: Database, read, and write configuration for the bitcoin-rs LevelDB port. Options selects the comparator, environment, cache, filter policy, file/block sizes, compression, and open/recovery behavior. ReadOptions controls read-side checksum/cache/snapshot choices; WriteOptions controls write synchronization.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-posix
manifest_changes.description_after: POSIX environment facade and file-descriptor test helpers for LevelDB.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-posixenv
manifest_changes.description_after: POSIX-backed operating-system services for the LevelDB storage engine.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-posixlogger
manifest_changes.description_after: POSIX diagnostic logger for the bitcoin-rs LevelDB environment. PosixLogger implements the subsystem's Logger/Logv traits and writes lines with time and thread labels to a C runtime FILE*.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-posixmmaprfile
manifest_changes.description_after: Read-only memory-mapped implementation of LevelDB's RandomAccessFile traits.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-posixrafile
manifest_changes.description_after: POSIX positioned reads for LevelDB random-access files.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-posixseqfile
manifest_changes.description_after: POSIX file-descriptor implementation of LevelDB's sequential-file interface. PosixSequentialFile::new(filename, fd) takes ownership of an already-open file descriptor; it does not open the named path. Dropping it closes the descriptor.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-posixtools
manifest_changes.description_after: POSIX locking, resource-limit, error, and environment helpers for LevelDB.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-posixwfile
manifest_changes.description_after: Buffered POSIX writes for LevelDB's WritableFile interface.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-rand
manifest_changes.description_after: Deterministic pseudo-random generator used by LevelDB tests and randomized data structures. Random implements the LevelDB-style Park–Miller sequence with a 31-bit state and multiplier 16807.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-repair
manifest_changes.description_after: Best-effort recovery of LevelDB database files.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-reversekeycomparator
manifest_changes.description_after: A comparator used to exercise non-default key ordering in LevelDB tests.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-skiplist
manifest_changes.description_after: Arena-backed ordered set used by the LevelDB memtable. SkipList<K, C> supports insertion, membership tests, ordered search, and traversal with SkipListIterator. Keys satisfy Debug + Copy + Default; comparisons are provided by SkipListComparator<K>.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-slice
manifest_changes.description_after: Non-owning byte views used throughout the LevelDB storage interfaces.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-snapshot
manifest_changes.description_after: Snapshot handles and the internal sequence-number snapshot list for LevelDB.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-specialenv
manifest_changes.description_after: Controllable environment wrapper for LevelDB tests. SpecialEnv wraps a shared Env and creates file wrappers that inject selected I/O behavior.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-status
manifest_changes.description_after: Result codes and diagnostic messages for LevelDB operations.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-stringsink
manifest_changes.description_after: An in-memory WritableFile used by LevelDB table construction and tests.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-stringsource
manifest_changes.description_after: In-memory RandomAccessFile implementation used by the LevelDB table and block tests. StringSource::new(&Slice) copies the supplied bytes into owned storage; the original input only needs to remain valid during construction.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-sync
manifest_changes.description_after: Scoped locking helper for LevelDB's raw-mutex call sites.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-table
manifest_changes.description_after: Reading immutable LevelDB table files.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-tablebuilder
manifest_changes.description_after: Writes immutable sorted LevelDB SSTable files. TableBuilder assembles data, index, filter, metaindex, and footer blocks, with checksums and the configured compression policy.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-tablecache
manifest_changes.description_after: Cache of opened LevelDB table files and their readers.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-tableconstructor
manifest_changes.description_after: An in-memory table-construction fixture for LevelDB iterator tests.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-tablerep
manifest_changes.description_after: Shared representation of an opened LevelDB SSTable, used by bitcoinleveldb-table. TableRep holds table-read options and status, a shared random-access file handle, cache identity, the metaindex handle, index block, and optional filter state.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-test
manifest_changes.description_after: Workspace dependency aggregate for LevelDB test crates.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-util
manifest_changes.description_after: Explicit destructor suppression for long-lived LevelDB support objects.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-version
manifest_changes.description_after: An SSTable-file view of the LevelDB database, used by bitcoinleveldb-versionset. Version records files per level, links to neighboring versions, reference counts, and compaction-selection state. Older versions remain available while live iterators still reference their file view.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-versionedit
manifest_changes.description_after: LevelDB manifest-edit records and their binary encoding.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-versioniterator
manifest_changes.description_after: An internal iterator over the files in one LevelDB version level.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-versionset
manifest_changes.description_after: Manages LevelDB's current and retained SSTable versions, MANIFEST edits, file-number/sequence bookkeeping, and compaction selection. VersionSet owns the linked version list and connects it to the table cache and environment.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-versionsetinterface
manifest_changes.description_after: Traits connecting LevelDB versions, compaction, and file-number allocation.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-versionsetutil
manifest_changes.description_after: Helpers used by LevelDB version management and compaction selection.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldb-writebatch
manifest_changes.description_after: C-API-style write-batch handles for the bitcoin-rs LevelDB port. LevelDBWriteBatch wraps the binary WriteBatch implementation in bitcoinleveldb-batch.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldbt-autocompaction
manifest_changes.description_after: Read-driven compaction regression tests and deterministic progress observations.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldbt-bench
manifest_changes.description_after: Benchmark workloads for the LevelDB port, with a separate SQLite comparison implementation.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldbt-capi
manifest_changes.description_after: Integration regression for the LevelDB port's C-API-style Rust functions.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldbt-corruption
manifest_changes.description_after: Database corruption, repair and recovery regressions.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldbt-dbtest
manifest_changes.description_after: Shared database fixture and core database regressions for the LevelDB port.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldbt-env
manifest_changes.description_after: An environment adapter used by LevelDB tests.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldbt-faultinjection
manifest_changes.description_after: Filesystem fault-injection and recovery tests for the LevelDB port.

manifest_changes.description_after: Regression for deleted data reappearing after manual compaction (upstream LevelDB issue 178).

manifest_changes.description_after: Mock version-set support used by the LevelDB port's fixtures.

manifest_changes.description_after: Multithreaded database read/write regression across fixture option configurations.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldbt-randomized
manifest_changes.description_after: Deterministic randomized, replay and failure-prefix regressions for the LevelDB port.

manifest_changes.description_after: Log and manifest recovery regressions for the LevelDB port.

manifest_changes.description_after: Snapshot behavior, lifetime and dispatch regressions for the LevelDB port.

manifest_changes.description_after: Sparse-merge compaction and environment-borrow regressions.

manifest_changes.name: bitcoinleveldbt-table
manifest_changes.description_after: Table-construction and approximate-offset regressions for the LevelDB port.
